title: Halifax City Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience the best of Halifax on one unforgettable city tour! Visit iconic landmarks including the Halifax Citadel, Public Gardens, Titanic Graves at Fairview Lawn Cemetery, Point Pleasant Park, and the vibrant Halifax Waterfront. Enjoy breathtaking views, fascinating local stories, and rich maritime history while discovering the city's unique charm. With plenty of photo opportunities and insights from a knowledgeable local guide, this tour is the perfect way to explore Halifax's top attractions in a fun, relaxing, and memorable experience.
